card.name: Second word of proper names
card.fires_on: The word that completes a proper name, such as Lane, House, Lakes, Landing, Laboratories or Theory, right after a rare name word. It also fires on a hyphenated 'Type' after Ergot.

modes.label: Place and street names
modes.description: Lane, House, Lake or Landing ending a street, building or place name in an address or news text.

modes.label: Company and theory names
modes.description: A closing noun such as Laboratories or Theory after a person or coined name.

modes.label: Ergot-Type heading
modes.description: The hyphenated Type after Ergot in the drug-interaction heading.
